from llm_wiki_cli import api
from llm_wiki_cli.api_types import KnowledgeMode, TaskStorageOptions

api.inspect_concept("llm-wiki://entities/Item", limit="twenty")  # expected: reportArgumentType
api.get_knowledge_coverage(live="now")  # expected: reportArgumentType
api.build_context(knowledge_mode="invented")  # expected: reportArgumentType
api.validate_context_packet("not bytes")  # expected: reportArgumentType
api.inspect_concept("llm-wiki://entities/Item", unexpected=True)  # expected: reportCallIssue
mode: KnowledgeMode = "invented"  # expected: reportAssignmentType
selection: TaskStorageOptions = {"selection": "invented"}  # expected: reportAssignmentType
receipt: TaskStorageOptions = {"receipt": "zip"}  # expected: reportAssignmentType
result = api.inspect_concept("llm-wiki://entities/Item")
count: str = result["cost"]["supplied_paths"]  # expected: reportAssignmentType
api.search_wiki("query", limit="many")  # expected: reportArgumentType
api.build_maintenance_queue(limit="many")  # expected: reportArgumentType
api.build_task_context("task text")  # expected: reportArgumentType
api.open_context_session(max_entries="many")  # expected: reportArgumentType
api.apply_task_delta(12, {}, {})  # expected: reportArgumentType
api.open_context_session().read({}, delta="yes")  # expected: reportArgumentType
